This site distills the agnostic line of inquiry I follow. The long-form content has playbooks, write-ups, and projects I learn from. There's also a mosaic of thoughts I collect along the way An agnostic inquiry into systems, featuring long-form content & a shifting mosaic of thoughts.

runtime cost ≠ system cost

Better hardware can mask noisy code for a long time. The cost becomes visible when the system needs to evolve.

Some ideas are clearer when they are shown. Some are clearer when they are said.

The form should follow the idea.

Observability and uncertainty

What cannot be predicted can still be observed.

A system built around one need can be complete but terminal.
What is common can form a core; what is specific can remain at the edges.

Understanding comes before optimisation

Some complexity is accidental. Some complexity is earned. What looks tangled from the outside may be the shape of things being brought together. Something that needs simplification may not have been understood yet.

Effort can make a path feel more necessary than it is. We get better at improving a path, and sometimes forget to ask whether it is still the path we want.

Computation scales more easily than coordination

Friction reveals what the system was built around.
